description: This Java source file defines the 'GlobalErrorRegistry' class, which is responsible for managing error deserialization strategies for subclasses of 'DittoRuntimeException'. It includes a singleton instance, methods to resolve error types from JSON objects, and nested classes that register specific error parsing strategies based on error codes. The class interacts with various JSON exception classes and annotations to facilitate JSON parsing and exception handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: GlobalErrorRegistry
classes.description: A singleton registry that handles deserialization strategies for 'DittoRuntimeException' subclasses based on JSON input, with nested classes for specific error code mappings and parsing strategies.

methods.name: resolveType
methods.description: Extracts the error code from a JSON object to determine the type of error for deserialization.
